name: M5.FactorProduct.common_factor_dvd
statement: ∀ F H A : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F ≠ 0 → F ∣ A → (F * H ∣ A ↔ H ∣ A / F)
guidance: Use EuclideanDomain.dvd_div_of_mul_dvd in one direction; use EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel' to reconstruct A from F*(A/F) in the reverse. A may be zero and F may share factors with H. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.
